context.purpose: Convert captured ASCII triangle/tetra meshes between VTU and legacy VTK 4.2 with explicit length units, exact ordered topology and preserved scalar/vector point/cell values. Strict subset refuses unsupported data before native mapping.
context.assumptions: Declared source/target length units; positive tetra orientation and nondegenerate triangles; POSIX meshio 5.3.5 isolated Python.
context.constraints: 16MiB source/32MiB output; 100000 points/cells; 16 scalar/vector arrays per association. No compressed/binary/appended/DTD/metadata/solver formats.
context.inspection: Independent stdlib source/output parsers compare transformed coordinates, ordered connectivity and every field tuple; separate native reopening checks consistency.
context.recovery: INVALID_MESH_SOURCE needs bounded regular matching path; INVALID_MESH_CONTENT needs supported intact ASCII geometry and positive orientation; inspect native logs for runtime failures.

workflow.scope: Verified geometry handoffs and source-byte reuse identity.

composition.scope: Finite unit/format studies resolve before conversion.

lifecycle.timeout: Single total deadline, shared process-tree runner; POSIX AS 2 GiB / FSIZE 32 MiB / CPU 60 s native caps.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned subprocess cancellation and prepublication cancellation check.
lifecycle.logs: Captured source/plan/config/worker; stdout/stderr/submissions and consumed-input bindings for conversion and fresh reopening.
lifecycle.verification: Independent stdlib format parsers compare original mesh transformed only in XYZ against output; separate native readback; known literal fixture oracle.

losses: Strict refusal of unsupported sections; no silent omissions.
Storage dtype/formatting and cell-block boundaries may change; numeric values and flattened order checked.
Coordinate units alone change; field units are not inferred.

inspection.scope: Bounds/counts/array names/signed tetra volumes and retained logs.
inspection.limits: Use a compatible geometry viewer for visual inspection; no mesh editing panel.

authoring.reuse: Edit path/formats/units then plan; source hashes invalidate changed bytes.
